name: easyscreenshot
description: easyscreenshot: give it a website and it picks the pages worth showing and saves clean desktop, mobile and full-page screenshots your coding agent can use.

plugins.name: easyscreenshot
plugins.description: Opens a product's website in a headless browser, picks the pages worth showing (home, pricing, features and the like), hides cookie banners and chat bubbles, and saves desktop, mobile and full-page PNGs with manifest.json and SCREENSHOTS.md.
